user.description: Enter an OpenAI Platform API key (pay-as-you-go; ChatGPT plans do not cover the API).

reauth_confirm.description: OpenAI rejected the stored API key. Enter a new one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the OpenAI API.

abort.already_configured: This API key is already set up.

decide.name: Decide
decide.description: Ask OpenAI's Decisions API questions about text and camera images. Returns a probability per predicate, the picked option and per-option probabilities per choice, and a weighted score per score question.

questions.name: Questions
questions.description: List of questions. Each needs name, instructions and type (predicate, the default; choice, with choices; or score, with ordered levels). Choices and levels can be plain strings or objects with value/label and description.

text.name: Text
text.description: Context sent with the images, or the whole input when there are no images.

camera_entity_id.name: Cameras
camera_entity_id.description: Cameras to take a snapshot from. Each frame is sent inline.

image_path.name: Image files
image_path.description: Local image files to send (must be in allowlist_external_dirs).

timeout.name: Timeout
timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the API.

config_entry_id.name: Config entry
config_entry_id.description: Which API key to use, if you set up more than one.
